verdict.rationale: Rippling offers workflow automation (custom workflows, triggers, Slack alerts) and flexible payroll run scheduling, which shows some recurring-job/workflow capability, but none of this is framed for AI-native/agentic scheduling or exposed via an API/CLI for programmatic recurring job scheduling. Missing for 10: explicit AI-agent-triggered or API/CLI-based recurring job scheduling, documentation of cron-like triggers, and independent verification of workflow automation depth.
